$comment: Descriptions for props whose types carry none, used in each page's API reference. Keys are `Part.prop` or a bare `prop` for every part. null hides a prop that is internal plumbing.
items: The items as data. Pass a function as the child to render each one.
Accordion.value: The values of the open items. Pass it to control the accordion.
Accordion.defaultValue: The items open at first, when uncontrolled.
Accordion.onValueChange: Runs when an item opens or closes, with the values of the open items.
Accordion.multiple: Allow several answers to stay open.
Accordion.collapsible: Allow the last open answer to close.
Accordion.keepMounted: Retain closed panels as hidden elements.
Accordion.hiddenUntilFound: Keep answers searchable by browser find.
Accordion.controller: Opens and closes items from anywhere.
Tabs.value: The selected tab's value. Pass it to control the tabs.
Tabs.onValueChange: Runs when another tab is selected.
Tabs.orientation: Controls the layout and arrow-key axis.
Tabs.activation: Automatic selects on focus; manual waits for Enter or Space.
Tabs.loop: Wraps arrow-key focus at either end.
Tabs.hiddenUntilFound: Keeps panels available for find in page.
Tabs.controller: Selects and focuses tabs from anywhere.
Avatar.fallbackDelay: How long to wait, in ms, before showing the fallback while the image loads.
DrawerClose.action: Runs when pressed, before the drawer closes. Return a promise to keep it open, pending, until it settles.
DrawerClose.value: Passed to `onOpenChange` as `details.returnValue` when this closes the drawer.
MotionStyle.preference: The preference to read and set. Defaults to the shared motion style, saved for the whole site.
MotionStyleSwitcher.preference: Motion preference instance; the default applies and saves the choice globally.
SidebarGroup.defaultOpen: Initial expanded state of a collapsible group.
SidebarGroup.open: Whether a collapsible group is open. Pass it to control the group.
SidebarGroup.onOpenChange: Runs when a collapsible group opens or closes.
SidebarMenuButton.href: Renders the item as a link to this address.
SkeletonSwap.loading: Shows the fallback until loading ends.
SkeletonSwap.fallback: Placeholder content that shares a grid cell with the loaded content.
ToastIcon.type: Which icon to draw. Match it to the toast's type.
PaginationRoll.value: The page number to show. It rolls to each new value.
TreeGroup.value: The value of the item this group belongs to.
TimelineConnector.status: Overrides the status this part takes from its item.
TimelineDescription.status: Overrides the status this part takes from its item.
TimelineMarker.status: Overrides the status this part takes from its item.
TimelineTime.status: Overrides the status this part takes from its item.
TimelineTitle.status: Overrides the status this part takes from its item.
useSidebar.collapsed: Whether the sidebar is narrowed to the icon rail.
useSidebar.setCollapsed: Narrows the sidebar to the rail, or widens it.
useSidebar.isMobile: Whether the provider is below `mobileBreakpoint`, so the sidebar is a sheet.
useSidebar.openMobile: Whether the sheet is open, on a phone.
useSidebar: Reads and changes the sidebar's state from any component inside `SidebarProvider`, like your own trigger in the page header.
useFieldControl: Connects a control of your own to the field it sits in, so the label, description and error message point at it.
AlertDialog.dismissible: Allow Escape to dismiss the confirmation. Outside presses never dismiss alert dialogs.
AlertDialogTrigger.focusableWhenDisabled: Keep a disabled trigger keyboard focusable.
AlertDialogClose.variant: Default, primary or destructive action appearance.
AlertDialogContent.keepMounted: Keep the closed dialog hidden in the DOM.
Alert.variant: How it reads: "default" for information, "destructive" for a problem.
Alert.open: Whether the alert is shown. Set it to control the alert yourself.
Alert.defaultOpen: Whether the alert starts shown, when you don't control it. Defaults to true.
Alert.onOpenChange: Runs when the alert is dismissed, with details.reason "close-press".
Alert.speed: How fast the alert moves: "fast", "normal", "slow" or a multiplier.
AspectRatio.ratio: Width divided by height, like 16 / 9. Defaults to 1.
AspectRatio.speed: How fast the frame and its image move: "fast", "normal", "slow" or a multiplier.
AspectRatioImage.alt: What the image shows. Leave it empty for a decorative image, which hides it from screen readers.
AspectRatioImage.children: Shown until the image has loaded, and if it fails, like a colour or a caption.
AspectRatioImage.onLoadingStatusChange: Runs when the image starts loading, loads or fails.
Autocomplete.filter: Match suggestions by contains, startsWith or fuzzy search.
Autocomplete.inlineComplete: Select the untyped suffix of the first matching suggestion.
Autocomplete.autoHighlight: Highlight the first match while typing.
Autocomplete.openOnFocus: Show recent recipes when the empty field gains focus.
Autocomplete.loop: Wrap arrow navigation at the ends.
Autocomplete.readOnly: Keep the input focusable while preventing edits.
Autocomplete.required: Require a nonempty value in form submission.
AutocompleteContent.side: Preferred popup side, subject to collisions.
AutocompleteContent.align: Align the suggestions with the field.
AutocompleteContent.sideOffset: Space from field to popup in pixels.
Avatar.size: Disc size: sm (24px), md (32px) or lg (40px); --avatar-size can override it.
AvatarFallback.delay: Milliseconds before initials appear while the photo loads.
AvatarGroupCount.size: Match the counter disc to the group avatar size.
Badge.count: Render a number with rolling digits.
Badge.dot: Show a status dot that pulses when its content changes.
BadgeDot.className: Classes for the status dot. It carries `data-pulse` (`odd` or `even`) after the first change.
Badge.variant: Default, secondary, outline, destructive or success appearance.
Breadcrumb.aria-label: Names the navigation landmark. Defaults to "Breadcrumb".
BreadcrumbSeparator.children: Your own mark between crumbs, like "/". Defaults to a chevron that draws itself.
BreadcrumbEllipsis.children: Your own mark for the pages left out. Defaults to three dots.
ButtonGroup.orientation: Lays the buttons out in a row (`"horizontal"`, the default) or a column (`"vertical"`).
ButtonGroupSeparator.orientation: Which way the line runs. Vertical by default, for a group laid out in a row.
ButtonGroupSeparator.decorative: Hides the line from assistive technology. On by default: it only joins two halves of one key.
Button.variant: Default, primary, ghost or destructive key appearance.
Button.size: sm, md, lg, icon-sm, icon or icon-lg dimensions.
Button.focusableWhenDisabled: Keep a disabled button in the tab order.
Button.pendingIndicator: Spinner replacement shown during an asynchronous action; null hides it.
Calendar.mode: Select one date, multiple dates or a start/end range.
Calendar.pageBy: Turn one month or a whole page of months.
Calendar.weekStartsOn: First weekday from 0 (Sunday) through 6 (Saturday); omit for locale.
Calendar.locale: Locale for month and weekday labels.
Calendar.deselectable: Allow pressing a selected single date to clear it.
Calendar.allowUnavailable: Allow ranges to cross unavailable dates.
Card.interactive: Enable hover lift and press feedback.
Card.spotlight: Show a soft wash following the pointer.
Carousel.orientation: Horizontal or vertical scrolling and arrow-key direction.
Carousel.align: Align each page to start, center or end.
Carousel.slidesPerPage: Number of slides each next/previous press advances.
Carousel.loop: Wrap around between the first and last pages.
Carousel.skipSnaps: Let fast swipes pass multiple pages.
Carousel.dragFree: Allow dragging to coast between snap points.
Carousel.drag: Enable dragging, swiping and wheel scrolling.
Carousel.playing: Automatically rotate pages; interaction can pause rotation.
Checkbox.parent: Control all values in the group and reflect its mixed state.
CheckboxGroup.readOnly: Allow focus without changing checked values.
CheckboxGroup.required: Require at least one checked item.
CodeBlock.code: The code to show and to copy. A trailing newline is ignored.
CodeBlock.startLine: The number of the first line.
CodeBlock.highlight: Line numbers, counted from startLine, to highlight.
CodeBlock.added: Line numbers to mark as added, for a diff.
CodeBlock.removed: Line numbers to mark as removed, for a diff.
CodeBlock.wrap: Wraps long lines instead of scrolling them.
CodeBlock.onCopy: Called with the code after the copy button copied it.
CodeBlock.variant: "destructive" for an error or failed output.
CodeBlock.size: "sm" has tighter padding and 12px code, for tool output.
CodeBlockLine.value: The line's number, as a string.
Collapsible.open: Control whether the intermediate stops are expanded.
Collapsible.disabled: Prevent trigger changes while keeping the trigger focusable.
CollapsiblePanel.keepMounted: Keep the closed panel hidden in the DOM.
CollapsiblePanel.hiddenUntilFound: Let browser find discover and open hidden stops.
ColorPicker.space: Channel space: hsv, hsl, srgb or oklch.
ColorPicker.format: CSS syntax used when reporting edited values.
ColorPicker.gamut: Limit to sRGB, Display P3 or no gamut limit (false).
ColorPicker.readOnly: Keep focus while preventing colour changes.
ColorPickerSlider.channel: The colour channel edited by the slider.
Combobox.multiple: Select several cities; chips show and remove selected values.
Combobox.keepQuery: Keep filtering text after choosing in multiple mode.
Combobox.allowCustomValue: Accept unmatched text as a value.
Combobox.autoHighlight: Always highlight on open, only while typing, or never automatically.
Command.autoHighlight: Highlight the first or best matching command automatically.
Command.loop: Wrap arrow navigation at either end.
Command.filter: Filter commands by fuzzy letters, contains or startsWith.
CommandItem.disabled: Skip disabled commands and prevent their actions.
CommandItem.page: Name of the nested command page to open.
ContextMenu.loop: Wrap arrow navigation at either end.
ContextMenu.dismissible: Allow Escape and outside presses to dismiss.
ContextMenuTrigger.disabled: Prevent the custom context menu from opening.
ContextMenuItem.closeOnSelect: Close after selecting a plain action.
ContextMenuContent.side: Preferred menu side relative to the press point.
ContextMenuContent.align: Menu alignment to the press anchor.
ContextMenuContent.sideOffset: Space from the press anchor in pixels.
DateInput.granularity: Smallest visible unit: day, hour, minute or second.
DateInput.hourCycle: 12 or 24 hour clock; omit for locale.
DateInput.readOnly: Show and focus the value without editing.
DateInput.required: Require a complete date before form submission.
DatePicker.mode: One date or a start/end range with two inputs.
DatePicker.required: Require a date before form submission.
DatePicker.closeOnSelect: Close after choosing a date or complete range.
DatePicker.dismissible: Allow Escape and outside presses to dismiss.
DatePicker.presentation: "auto" (the default here) is a popover on wide screens and a sheet from the bottom edge on small touch screens; "popover" floats everywhere; "sheet" always slides up.
DatePickerContent.side: Preferred side of the date field.
Dialog.modal: true blocks the page; trap-focus traps focus only; false allows the page beside the dialog.
Dialog.presentation: "dialog" (the default) is centred; "sheet" slides up from the bottom edge; "auto" does that only on small touch screens.
Dialog.dismissible: Allow Escape and back gesture dismissal.
Dialog.closeOnOutsidePress: Dismiss after an outside press is released.
DialogTrigger.disabled: Prevent the trigger opening the dialog.
DialogTrigger.focusableWhenDisabled: Keep the disabled trigger keyboard focusable.
DialogContent.keepMounted: Keep closed dialog content hidden in the DOM.
DialogClose.variant: Default, primary, destructive or corner icon key.
Drawer.side: Edge to open from; start and end follow writing direction.
Drawer.modal: Modal, focus trap only or non-modal interaction.
Drawer.driver: Automatic, pointer spring or native scroll snap movement.
Drawer.dismissible: Allow Escape, back and swipe dismissal.
Empty.announce: Reads the title and description to screen readers when the empty state appears, as after a search that finds nothing.
EmptyMedia.variant: "icon" puts an icon in a raised tile; "default" holds anything, like photos.
Empty.speed: How fast the empty state moves: "fast", "normal", "slow" or a multiplier.
Field.invalid: Force invalid or valid display; omit for browser validation after submission.
Field.disabled: Disable the control and mark every part.
FieldSet.disabled: Disable all controls except those in its legend.
FieldError.match: Validity key for displaying an error, or true/false to force it.
FileInput.multiple: Append multiple accepted files instead of replacing one.
FileInput.directory: Choose an entire folder; enables multiple files.
FileInput.capture: false for file picker, true/default camera, user/front or environment/back camera.
FileInput.required: Require at least one file before form submission.
FileInput.disabled: Disable picking, drops, pastes and file actions.
FileInput.accept: MIME types, wildcards or extensions to accept.
FileInput.maxFiles: Maximum number of files in total.
FileInput.maxSize: Maximum accepted file size in bytes.
FileInput.minSize: Minimum accepted file size in bytes.
Form.submit: Runs when the form is submitted and every field is valid, with the form's data. Return `{ errors: { name: message } }` to show your messages on those fields, and `{ message }` for one line about the whole form. Throwing refuses the submission with the error's message. Leave it out to submit the browser's way.
Form.onStatusChange: Called as the submission moves between `idle`, `submitting`, `success` and `error`, with the reason.
Form.resetOnSuccess: Clears the fields once a submission succeeds. The success stays until the next edit.
FormSubmit.pendingLabel: What the button says while the form submits.
FormSubmit.successLabel: What the button says once the submission succeeds.
HoverCard.disabled: Disables the preview while retaining the trigger link.
HoverCard.delay: Milliseconds before a hovered or focused link opens its preview.
HoverCard.closeDelay: Milliseconds before leaving the link and card closes the preview.
HoverCardContent.side: Preferred side; collision handling may flip the card.
HoverCardContent.align: Aligns the card to the start, center or end of the link.
HoverCardContent.sideOffset: Gap in pixels between the link and card.
HoverCardContent.alignOffset: Offset in pixels along the alignment axis.
ImageCropper.mode: Box moves a crop over the image; frame pans the image under a fixed crop.
ImageCropper.aspectRatio: Locks width divided by height; omit for a free crop.
ImageCropper.disabled: Disables crop dragging, keyboard controls, zoom, rotate and flip.
ImageCropper.minWidth: Smallest crop width in image pixels.
ImageCropper.minHeight: Smallest crop height in image pixels.
InputGroupAddon.align: Where the addon sits: `"inline-start"` (before the input, the default), `"inline-end"` (after it), `"block-start"` (above a textarea) or `"block-end"` (below it).
InputGroupCount.show: `"used"` shows how many characters the field holds (with `/maxLength` when it has one); `"left"` shows how many are left under its `maxLength`.
InputGroupButton.size: `"xs"` (24px, the default), `"sm"` (28px), `"icon-xs"` or `"icon-sm"` for a square icon button.
InputGroupButton.variant: Which Button look to use. Ghost by default, so it sits quietly inside the field.
Input.disabled: Prevents editing and removes the input from the tab order.
Input.readOnly: Prevents editing while permitting focus and selection.
Input.required: Requires a value for native form validation.
Input.type: Native input type, such as text, search, email or url.
Input.defaultValue: Initial editable value; the demo remounts when its destination control changes.
InputGroup.children: Input, optional text or icons, and an optional InputClear button.
Item.variant: The surface: `"default"` is bare, `"outline"` has a hairline, `"muted"` a soft fill.
Item.size: `"sm"` tightens the padding and the gap.
ItemMedia.variant: `"icon"` puts the icon in a small well, `"image"` crops a picture to a rounded square, `"default"` leaves it as it is.
Label.htmlFor: ID of the control the label names and focuses when pressed.
Label.children: The visible label and optional LabelMarker content.
LabelMarker.children: Required or optional text shown beside the label.
Listbox.multiple: Uses an array of selected values; pressing options toggles them by default.
Listbox.orientation: Vertical uses Up/Down; horizontal uses Left/Right.
Listbox.activation: Automatic follows focus; manual waits for a press. Omit to use the SDK default for the selection mode.
Listbox.loop: Wraps keyboard navigation at the first and last enabled option.
Listbox.deselectable: Allows pressing the current single selection to clear it.
Listbox.keepInView: Scrolls the focused or initially selected option into view.
Listbox.readOnly: Allows browsing while preventing value changes.
Listbox.required: Requires a selected value for native form submission.
Marker.variant: `"separator"` draws a rule on each side of the content, `"border"` a rule under it, `"default"` neither.
Marker.live: Reads the marker out when its text changes, as a status.
Marker.pending: The work the marker names is still going on: a light sweeps across the words, and a live marker is marked busy.
Menu.loop: Wraps arrow-key navigation at the ends of a menu.
Menu.dismissible: Allows Escape and outside interactions to close the menu.
Menu.presentation: "auto" (the default here) is a popover on wide screens and a sheet from the bottom edge on small touch screens; "popover" floats everywhere; "sheet" always slides up.
Menu.modal: Pointer mode consumes the outside press; true also traps focus and locks scroll; false allows outside interaction.
MenuTrigger.disabled: Prevents the trigger from opening the menu.
MenuTrigger.focusableWhenDisabled: Keeps a disabled trigger focusable with aria-disabled.
MenuContent.align: Start, center or end alignment relative to the trigger.
MenuContent.sideOffset: Gap from the trigger, in pixels.
MenuItem.closeOnSelect: Whether a plain menu action closes the menu.
MenuItem.destructive: Marks a dangerous action with destructive styling.
Menubar.orientation: Horizontal uses Left/Right; vertical uses Up/Down between triggers.
Menubar.loop: Wraps between triggers and open menus.
Menubar.disabled: Prevents menus from opening while retaining discoverable disabled triggers.
Menubar.modal: Shared modality for the menus: pointer, true or false.
MenuItem.disabled: Keeps the menu item discoverable while preventing activation.
Meter.value: Measurement to display; the fill clamps to the range.
Meter.min: Lower end of the range, default 0.
Meter.max: Upper end of the range, default 100.
Meter.high: Styled-wrapper threshold above which the fill and value use the danger colour.
Meter.format: Intl number options or a formatting function.
Meter.locale: Number-formatting locale; omit for the page or browser locale.
MotionStyleSwitcher.orientation: Horizontal or vertical arrangement and keyboard navigation.
MotionStyleSwitcher.disabled: Disables changes to the selected style.
MotionStyleSwitcher.readOnly: Retains focus and browsing while preventing changes.
MotionStyleSwitcher.required: Requires a selected style when used in a form.
NativeSelect.wrapperClassName: Class names for the wrapper that holds the select, its label and the chevron. Pass `w-full` to fill the row.
NativeSelect.valueClassName: Class names for the chosen option's label, drawn over the select.
NativeSelect.icon: Your own chevron, in place of the default one.
NativeSelectOption.value: The option's value. Required: it keys the option and is what `value` and `onValueChange` use.
NavigationMenu.orientation: Controls top-level layout, keyboard directions and the default panel side.
NavigationMenu.openOnHover: Resting on a trigger opens its panel; presses always work.
NavigationMenu.closeOnSelect: Closes after an ordinary link selection.
NavigationMenuContent.keepMounted: Keeps closed panel content in the document, hidden.
NavigationMenuContent.hiddenUntilFound: Allows browser find to open matching closed panels; implies keepMounted.
NavigationMenuViewport.side: Preferred side; omit to follow the menu orientation.
NavigationMenuViewport.align: Start, center or end alignment with the open trigger.
NavigationMenuLink.current: Marks the current page and positions the indicator there while closed.
NumberInput.value: Controlled number, or null for an empty field.
NumberInput.step: Amount added or removed by one step.
NumberInput.readOnly: Retains focus and submission while preventing changes.
NumberInput.required: Requires a number when submitted in a form.
NumberInput.wheel: Allows wheel events to step a focused input.
NumberInputScrubArea.orientation: Horizontal scrubbing increases to the right; vertical increases upwards.
OTPInput.maxLength: Number of characters and visual slots.
OTPInput.pattern: Accepts digits, letters, alphanumeric characters or a per-character regular expression.
OTPInput.textAlign: Position of text and caret in the hidden native input; affects native phone popups.
OTPInput.readOnly: Allows focus while preventing code changes.
OTPInput.required: Requires a complete code in a form.
OTPInputSlot.index: Zero-based character rendered by the slot.
Pagination.total: Total results, used with pageSize to derive page count.
Pagination.pageSize: Number of results on each page.
Pagination.siblings: Visible page numbers on either side of the current page.
Pagination.boundaries: Visible pages at each end of the range.
PaginationPrevious.children: Custom label; omitted content uses the default chevron.
PaginationNext.children: Custom label; omitted content uses the default chevron.
PasswordInput.visible: Controls visibility; update with onVisibleChange so the eye toggle remains interactive.
PasswordInput.disabled: Disables the field and its toggle.
PasswordInput.readOnly: Prevents editing while leaving visibility toggling available.
PasswordInput.required: Requires a password before form submission.
PasswordInputToggle.children: Optional custom icon or render function of the visible state.
Popover.modal: False leaves outside content usable; true traps focus and locks scroll; trap-focus traps focus while leaving outside content usable.
Popover.presentation: "auto" (the default here) is a popover on wide screens and a sheet from the bottom edge on small touch screens; "popover" floats everywhere; "sheet" always slides up.
Popover.dismissible: Allows Escape and outside interactions to close the popup.
Popover.openOnHover: Opens after resting on the trigger, while retaining press activation.
PopoverTrigger.disabled: Prevents the trigger from opening the popup.
PopoverTrigger.focusableWhenDisabled: Keeps a disabled trigger in the tab order.
PopoverContent.side: Preferred side, subject to collision handling.
PopoverContent.align: Alignment with the trigger along that side.
PopoverContent.sideOffset: Gap between trigger and popup in pixels.
PopoverContent.keepMounted: Keeps closed content in the document, hidden.
PopoverClose.variant: Default raised key or primary action styling.
Preferences.preferences: Preference instances whose data attributes should apply to the subtree or page.
PreferenceSwitcher.preference: Preference instance to read and update.
PreferenceSwitcher.labels: Optional visible labels by preference value.
PreferenceSwitcher.readOnly: Keeps focus available while preventing changes.
PreferenceSwitcher.required: Requires a selected value when used in a form.
Progress.value: Numeric progress, or null for an indeterminate task.
Progress.format: Intl options or custom formatting function, shared by the visible and accessible value.
ProgressValue.children: Optional custom content; omit for the animated formatted value.
RadioGroup.value: Controlled selected option value, or null.
RadioGroup.disabled: Prevents focus and changes for all radios.
RadioGroup.readOnly: Keeps keyboard focus available while preventing selection changes.
RadioGroup.required: Requires a selected option on form submission.
RadioGroup.loop: Wraps keyboard navigation at either end.
Radio.disabled: Skips an individual radio during navigation and prevents checking it.
Rating.value: Controlled score, or null before a score is chosen.
Rating.max: Number of stars in the interactive rating.
Rating.step: Smallest selectable fraction of a star.
Rating.disabled: Disables every star and excludes the value from forms.
Rating.readOnly: Displays a non-interactive image labelled with the rating.
Rating.required: Requires a rating before submitting a form.
Rating.loop: Wraps keyboard navigation at either end.
Rating.deselectable: Pressing the chosen score again clears it.
Resizable.orientation: Horizontal panels sit side by side; vertical panels stack.
Resizable.disabled: Disables every handle and removes them from the tab order.
ResizablePanel.defaultSize: Initial panel size as a percentage or CSS length.
ResizablePanel.collapsible: Allows dragging, Enter or double-click to collapse below the minimum.
ResizablePanel.collapsedSize: Size of the collapsed panel; zero also hides its content from focus and accessibility.
ResizableHandle.children: Omit for the default grip, or pass null for a bare divider.
ScrollArea.type: Hover, scroll, auto or always visibility for the custom scrollbars.
ScrollArea.scrollHideDelay: Milliseconds before hover or scroll bars hide after activity.
ScrollArea.stickToEnd: Starts at the end and follows growing content until the user scrolls away.
ScrollAreaViewport.aria-label: Accessible name for the scrollable region.
SegmentedControl.orientation: Horizontal by default; vertical stacks the items.
SegmentedControl.readOnly: Keeps focus and the selected value, while preventing changes.
SegmentedControl.required: Requires a checked value in a form.
SegmentedControlItem.disabled: Skips this item during selection and keyboard navigation.
Select.multiple: Allows several values; the popup stays open while choosing.
Select.required: Requires a value for form submission.
Select.dismissible: Allows outside presses and Escape to close the popup.
Select.presentation: "auto" (the default here) is a popover on wide screens and a sheet from the bottom edge on small touch screens; "popover" floats everywhere; "sheet" always slides up.
Select.modal: Controls outside pointer interaction and page modality.
SelectContent.side: Preferred popup side, subject to available space.
SelectContent.sideOffset: Gap between trigger and popup in pixels.
SelectContent.alignItemWithTrigger: Overlaps the chosen row with the trigger.
Separator.orientation: Horizontal or vertical; vertical stretches to the row height.
Separator.decorative: Uses role none for lines whose meaning is already conveyed.
SeparatorLabel.children: The label between two decorative lines.
SidebarProvider.collapsed: Whether the sidebar is narrowed to the icon rail. Pass it to control the sidebar.
SidebarProvider.onCollapsedChange: Runs when the sidebar wants to narrow or widen, with `details.reason` (`"trigger-press"` or `"imperative"`).
SidebarProvider.openMobile: Whether the sheet is open on a narrow screen. Pass it to control the sheet.
SidebarProvider.onOpenMobileChange: Runs when the sheet wants to open or close, with `details.reason`: `"trigger-press"`, `"item-press"`, `"escape-key"`, `"outside-press"` or `"breakpoint"`.
SidebarProvider.mobileBreakpoint: Provider width below which the sidebar becomes a sheet.
SidebarProvider.speed: How fast the sidebar moves: `"fast"`, `"normal"`, `"slow"` or a multiplier like `0.8`.
SidebarMenuButton.isActive: Marks the current page for the moving highlight.
SidebarMenuButton.tooltip: Names the item with a native tooltip while the sidebar is a rail.
SidebarGroup.collapsible: Lets the group label fold its content.
Skeleton.shimmer: Enables the sweeping band; reduced motion keeps it still.
SkeletonSwap.contentClassName: Classes for the content layer. Its direct children cascade in when loading ends.
Slider.orientation: Horizontal by default; vertical increases upward.
Slider.readOnly: Allows focus while preventing value changes.
Slider.required: Marks the slider required; it always has a value.
Slider.value: A number for one thumb, or a number array for a range.
Spinner.label: What a screen reader hears. Defaults to "Loading".
Spinner.variant: The drawing: "ring", an arc that turns and stretches, or "spokes", eight spokes fading round.
Spinner.speed: How fast it turns: "fast", "normal", "slow" or a multiplier.
Switch.defaultChecked: Initial checked state; a form reset restores it.
Switch.disabled: Disables pointer, keyboard and form submission.
Switch.readOnly: Keeps focus and submission while preventing toggles.
Switch.required: Requires the switch to be on for form submission.
TableHead.sort: Controlled ascending, descending, or none; undefined makes the header static.
TableHead.defaultSort: How this column is sorted at first, when you don't control `sort`. Makes the header a sort button that keeps its own sort.
TableHead.onSort: Called when the sort button is pressed.
TableHead.onSortChange: Runs when the sort changes, with the next direction and the change's details (`reason`, `source`, `cancel()`). Makes the header a sort button.
TableRow.selected: Marks the row selected and applies its selection tint.
TabsTab.disabled: Keeps focusable tabs from being selected.
Textarea.autoResize: Grows with content between the minimum and maximum heights.
Textarea.readOnly: Keeps the field focusable while preventing edits.
Textarea.required: Requires a value before form submission.
Textarea.submitShortcut: Enter or Mod+Enter can commit; Shift+Enter retains a newline with Enter.
TimeInput.granularity: Smallest visible unit: hour, minute, or second.
TimeInput.required: Requires a complete time for form submission.
Timeline.orientation: Vertical list or horizontal roadmap, with matching arrow keys.
Timeline.feed: Uses a feed of articles instead of a list.
TimelineItem.status: Complete, current, upcoming, or undefined for an event.
ToastRegion.side: Top or bottom edge of the viewport.
ToastRegion.align: Start, centre, or end alignment along the edge.
Toast.dismissible: Allows swipe, Escape and Close to dismiss.
Toast.type: Controls the status icon and announcement priority.
ToastAction.dismiss: Dismisses after the action is used.
Toggle.size: sm, md, icon-sm, or icon; defaults to md.
Toggle.focusableWhenDisabled: Keeps a disabled standalone toggle discoverable in the tab order.
ToggleGroup.deselectable: Allows clearing the last value in a single-select group.
TokenInput.readOnly: Allows focus and copying while preventing editing.
TokenInput.required: Requires a nonempty value for form submission.
TokenInput.tokenDeletion: Backspace removes, selects first, or reverts a token to text.
TokenInput.copy: Copies codec text or the human-readable label.
TokenInputEditor.placeholder: Shown while the editor has no text or tokens.
TokenInput.renderToken: Renders each token including its optional status.
Toolbar.orientation: Horizontal or vertical layout and keyboard axis.
Toolbar.disabled: Disables every item, keeping the toolbar discoverable.
ToolbarButton.focusableWhenDisabled: Keeps disabled items reachable with arrow keys.
ToolbarToggleGroup.deselectable: Allows clearing a single selected alignment.
Tooltip.disabled: Stops opening while leaving the trigger usable.
Tooltip.toggleable: Allows press to show and hide the tooltip.
Tooltip.delay: Hover wait before opening in milliseconds.
Tooltip.type: Uses the text as a label or a description.
TooltipContent.side: Preferred side; flips if space is limited.
TraceLine.status: "running", "error" or "pending". Leave it out once the step is done.
TraceIcon.children: Your own icon. Without one, the icon shows the line's status.
Tree.mode: Single selection, multiple selection, or no selection.
Tree.activation: Automatic selects focused items; manual waits for activation.
Tree.expandOnPress: Lets a branch row toggle expansion.
Tree.checkStrategy: Reports checked leaves, trunks, all branches, or independent items.
Tree.keepMounted: Keeps collapsed groups mounted and hidden.
Tree.hiddenUntilFound: Lets browser find in page expand a hidden branch.
Tree.current: Marks the current page and expands its ancestors.
TriggerMenu.autoHighlight: Highlights the first match so Enter and Tab can choose it.
TriggerMenu.dismissible: Allows Escape and outside press to dismiss.
TriggerMenu.triggers: Trigger characters, suggestion items, filtering and insertion rules.
TriggerMenuContent.side: Preferred side of the caret anchor.
TriggerMenuContent.sideOffset: Gap from the text line to the popup.
Waterfall.items: Nested spans with unique values, starts and durations.
Waterfall.range: Visible time interval; omit to fit the data.
WaterfallAxis.maxTicks: Maximum number of round-time ticks; may render fewer.
WaterfallMark.time: Time of the mark in milliseconds.
Calendar.minDays: Minimum inclusive span for a range; omit for no additional limit.
Chart.data: The rows. Each has its category under `categoryKey` and a number under each series' key.
Chart.config: The series by key, shaped like shadcn's `ChartConfig`: `{ revenue: { label, color?, icon? } }`. Config order is stack and legend order; a series without a colour takes the next of `--chart-1` … `--chart-5`. For a pie or donut, label each slice by its category here too.
Chart.categoryKey: The key that names each row: the category for bars, lines and areas, the slice for a ring. Add it to the config with a `label` to name it in the data table.
Chart.stacked: Stacks bars or areas on one another, in config order, instead of side by side. On arrival each stack builds up from the baseline segment by segment; the tooltip and each point's name add the total; switching a series off in the legend re-stacks the rest with a tween.
Chart.orientation: For bars: "vertical" (standing, the default) or "horizontal" (lying, categories down the side).
Chart.curve: For lines and areas: "smooth" (the default, never overshooting a point) or "linear".
Chart.dots: Shows a dot on every point of a line or area, not only on the active one.
Chart.categoryGap: The share of each category left empty between bar groups, 0 to 0.9. Defaults to 0.3.
Chart.innerRadius: The donut's hole as a share of its radius, 0 to 0.9. Defaults to 0.6 for a donut, 0 for a pie.
Chart.padAngle: Degrees of space between slices. Defaults to 1.5.
Chart.formatValue: Formats a value for the tooltip, the point names and the data table: `(value, seriesKey) => string`.
Chart.formatTick: Formats a value on the value axis. Defaults to compact numbers, like 12k.
Chart.formatCategory: Formats a category on the category axis, like `(month) => month.slice(0, 3)`. The tooltip keeps the full name.
Chart.activeIndex: The row that is active (hovered, focused or pressed), controlled. `null` for none.
Chart.defaultActiveIndex: The row active at first, when you don't control it.
Chart.onActiveIndexChange: Runs when the active row changes, with details.reason "item-hover", "item-press", "list-navigation", "focus-in", "focus-out", "escape-key" or "pointer-leave".
Chart.hiddenSeries: The series keys (slice categories for a ring) that are hidden, controlled. The last one shown can't be hidden.
Chart.defaultHiddenSeries: The series hidden at first, when you don't control them.
Chart.onHiddenSeriesChange: Runs when a legend item is pressed, with the next list of hidden keys.
Chart.speed: How fast the chart moves: "fast", "normal", "slow" or a multiplier.
ChartTooltip.indicator: The swatch beside each value: "dot" (the default), "line" or "dashed".
ChartTooltip.hideLabel: Leaves out the category at the top of the tooltip.
DataTable.columns: The columns, in order: `{ id, header, accessor?, cell?, sortable?, sortValue?, hideable?, searchable?, filter?: { title?, options }, align?, sticky?, hideBelow?, className? }`. `accessor` is a key or a function and defaults to `row[id]`; `cell(row, value)` renders the cell.
DataTable.label: The table's name, for screen readers and agents, like "Orders".
DataTable.getRowId: Each row's id for selection and keys. Defaults to `row.id`, then the index.
DataTable.loading: Draws skeleton rows at the table's own geometry, one per row of the page.
DataTable.selectable: Adds a checkbox to every row and a select-all for the page. Defaults to true.
DataTable.pageSizes: The choices under "Rows per page". Defaults to 10, 20, 30, 40 and 50.
DataTable.sort: `{ id, direction: "ascending" | "descending" }` or `null`, controlled; with `defaultSort` and `onSortChange`.
DataTable.search: The search text, controlled; with `defaultSearch` and `onSearchChange`. It looks in the columns marked `searchable`.
DataTable.filters: The chosen values per column, like `{ payment: ["Paid"] }`, controlled; with `defaultFilters` and `onFiltersChange`. Changing a filter or the search goes back to page 1.
DataTable.hiddenColumns: The ids of hidden columns, controlled; with `defaultHiddenColumns` and `onHiddenColumnsChange`. One column always stays.
DataTable.selected: The ids of selected rows on every page, controlled; with `defaultSelected` and `onSelectedChange`.
DataTable.page: The page from 1, controlled; with `defaultPage` and `onPageChange`. A page past the end after the data shrinks moves back to the last one.
DataTable.pageSize: Rows per page, controlled; with `defaultPageSize` (10) and `onPageSizeChange`.
DataTable.rowActions: `(row) => MenuItem`s for the row menu ("…"). Leave it out for no row menu.
DataTable.toolbar: More controls at the end of the toolbar, before View.
DataTable.emptyTitle: What the empty state says. Defaults to "No results".
DataTableBulkAction.label: The action's name; it folds to icon only on a narrow container and stays for screen readers.
rowModel: The row model as a plain function: `rowModel({ data, columns, search, filters, sort, page, pageSize })` returns the page's rows, the total, the page count and the facet counts, for the same rows on a server.
DescriptionList.layout: "rows" (labels in a fixed column, hairlines between, the default), "stacked" (label above value) or "grid". All three stack below 28rem.
DescriptionList.columns: For the grid: how many columns at full width, 1 to 4. Defaults to 2. Fewer show when a column would be under 11rem.
DescriptionList.truncate: Keeps long values on one line with an ellipsis and the full text as a title. Off, they wrap.
DescriptionList.speed: How fast it moves: "fast", "normal", "slow" or a multiplier.
DescriptionListItem.value: An id for the item, when you need to key it.
DescriptionListActions: Holds buttons or links at the end of a value: a copy button, an Edit button.
DescriptionListCopy.value: The text to copy. Leave it out to copy the value beside the button.
DescriptionListCopy.label: What the value is called, for the button's name ("Copy Email"). Read from the item's label when left out.
Filter.label: The column or facet, like "Status". Names the chip, the search field and the filter for agents.
Filter.options: The values: `{ value, label, icon?, count?, disabled? }`. `count` shows at the row's end and rolls when it changes.
Filter.value: The chosen values, controlled. Always a list of strings, also with `multiple={false}`.
Filter.defaultValue: The chosen values at first, when uncontrolled.
Filter.onValueChange: Runs with the next list. `details.reason` is "item-press", "clear-press", "reset-press", "backspace-key" or "imperative"; `details.cancel()` keeps the current value.
Filter.multiple: Several values (the default) or one that replaces the last and closes the list.
Filter.maxBadges: How many chosen values show as badges before they read "3 selected". Defaults to 2.
Filter.placeholder: The search field's placeholder. Defaults to the label.
Filter.emptyText: What the list says when nothing matches. Defaults to "No results."
Filter.hideSearch: Leaves out the search field, for short lists.
Filter.open: Whether the list is open, controlled, with `defaultOpen` and `onOpenChange`.
Filter.speed: How fast it moves: "fast", "normal", "slow" or a multiplier.
FilterBar.onReset: Runs when Reset is pressed, before the filters clear. `details.cancel()` stops the reset.
Sparkline.labels: A name for each point, like "Nov 12", shown in the readout and read out for each point.
Sparkline.curve: "smooth" (the default, never overshooting a point) or "linear".
Sparkline.label: What it measures, like "Revenue". Starts the accessible summary and the name agents see.
Sparkline.period: The span it covers, like "last 14 days". The summary reads "Revenue, last 14 days, up 12%".
Sparkline.formatValue: Formats a value for the readout and the point names: `(value) => string`.
Sparkline.trendColor: Draws in the colour of its news: green when the trend is good, the destructive colour when bad, muted when flat.
Sparkline.downIsGood: A fall is good news (refunds, churn, response time): the tone, and so the trend colour, turns round.
Sparkline.flatThreshold: A change from the first point to the last smaller than this share counts as flat. Defaults to 0.01.
Sparkline.reference: A value to draw a dashed line at: a target, a budget, last period's average. `null` for none.
Sparkline.extremes: Marks the highest and the lowest point with a hollow dot.
Sparkline.includeZero: Keeps zero in the value range. Defaults to true for bars and false for lines and areas.
Sparkline.activeIndex: The point being read (hovered or focused), controlled. `null` for none.
Sparkline.defaultActiveIndex: The point shown at first, when you don't control it.
Sparkline.onActiveIndexChange: Runs when the point being read changes, with details.reason "item-hover", "item-press", "list-navigation", "focus-in", "focus-out", "escape-key" or "pointer-leave".
Sparkline.speed: How fast it moves: "fast", "normal", "slow" or a multiplier.
Stat.label: What the number is, like "Revenue". Shown by StatLabel and names the stat for screen readers and agents.
Stat.delta: The change against the comparison period, as a share: 0.124 is up 12.4%. `null` hides the delta.
Stat.formatDelta: Formats the delta's size (the arrow carries the sign). Defaults to "12%", or "4.2%" under ten.
Stat.downIsGood: A fall is good news (refunds, churn, costs): a negative delta turns green and a positive one red. A Sparkline inside StatChart follows the delta's colour.
Stat.flatThreshold: A delta smaller than this counts as flat (muted, arrow level). Defaults to 0.0005.
Stat.loading: Shows placeholders at each part's own size. Keep passing the last value so the placeholders keep their width.
Stat.speed: How fast it moves: "fast", "normal", "slow" or a multiplier.
StatComparison.children: What the delta compares against, like "vs previous 30 days".
StatIcon.children: A lucide icon, drawn at 14px in a small well beside the label.
StatChart.children: A Sparkline (or any small chart). It takes the delta's colour unless you set `--sparkline-color`.
StatGroup.aria-label: Names the group, like "Store, last 30 days".
StatGroup.gridClassName: Classes for the grid the stats sit in.
Stepper.steps: The steps, in order: `{ value, label, description?, error?, disabled? }`.
Stepper.defaultValue: The current step at first, when uncontrolled. Defaults to the first.
Stepper.onValueChange: Runs with the next step. `details.reason` is "item-press", "next-press", "previous-press" or "imperative"; `details.cancel()` stays, like a step that doesn't validate.
Stepper.completed: The steps that are done. Defaults to every step before the furthest one reached. Pass every value for a finished flow.
Stepper.interactive: Steps are buttons (the default). Off, it is a read-only progress strip with `aria-current="step"` on the current one.
Stepper.linear: Forward only through `next`, back to any step reached (the default). Off, any step can be chosen.
Stepper.speed: How fast it moves: "fast", "normal", "slow" or a multiplier.
StepperList.children: Optional: a function of `{ steps }` to lay the steps out yourself with `StepperItem`, `StepperStep`, `StepperIndicator`, `StepperTitle`, `StepperDescription` and `StepperConnector`.
StepperPanel.value: The step whose content this is. Shown while that step is current.
Autocomplete.presentation: "auto" (the default here) is a popover on wide screens and a sheet from the bottom edge on small touch screens; "popover" floats everywhere; "sheet" always slides up.
Combobox.presentation: "auto" (the default here) is a popover on wide screens and a sheet from the bottom edge on small touch screens; "popover" floats everywhere; "sheet" always slides up.
